descriptions.w3d_d26a_ray_query_next_800400f0: Advances the global cursor over the item vector 0x804273ec, skipping the ignored index, items whose mask misses the query mask and the excluded owner. Solves the ray-sphere quadratic for each item; on a hit within the limit it stores the entry time, a flag for the exit time being past the limit, the integer time and the index. Returns the index, or 0xffff at the end.
